1. Contexto Científico y Agronómico

Dominio: agriculture

Tipo de Problema: regression

Objetivo de Negocio / Investigación: Enable climate-resilient agriculture by simulating yield impacts under 4 SSP scenarios (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, SSP5-8.5 for 2030, 2050, 2070) and prescribing adaptation strategies (planting date, variety, irrigation).

Descripción: Predict maize yield under climate change scenarios using physics-informed neural networks (CeresPINN). Coupled bias-corrected downscaled CMIP6 projections (NASA NEX-GDDP, 5 GCMs) with CHIRPS/CHIRTS historical climate and SoilGrids 2.0. Output: continuous yield with uncertainty quantification (GCM ensemble IQR, 95% CI), flowering date, maturity date, and accumulated ET.
